This notebook was scaffolded by `scripts/generate_distribution_notebooks.R`
from the outlier-analysis targets factory (`_targets.R`,
`R/fct_outlier_groups.R`, `R/fct_outlier_detection.R`,
`R/fct_outlier_report.R`). The plots/tables below are generated, but
analysis and interpretation are added by hand, section by section.
Re-running the generator only appends sections for groups not yet present
here -- it never rewrites or removes anything you have written.

See [NBXX-Outliers.qmd](NBXX-Outliers.qmd) for the fully hand-authored
*G. morhua* liver case study this workflow was built from, including
year/site/campaign breakdowns and the reasoning behind the outlier flags.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(targets)
library(patchwork)
library(flextable)
pkgload::load_all(quiet = TRUE)

set_flextable_defaults(
  font.size = 10,
  font.family = "Arial",
  digits = 2,
  theme_fun = theme_vanilla,
  padding = 1
)

ggplot_base_size <- 20
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = ggplot_base_size, base_family = "Aptos"))
```

## Abramis brama: Gill

Fish / Abramis brama / Gill. Flags are computed separately within each year/site/campaign
group below (Tukey fences x RMZ, `n < 10` not tested); the final
figure compares Winsorization/trimming of the pooled distribution.

TODO: add your own analysis/interpretation of this group here.

```{r}
#| label: read-Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill
grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill <- tar_read(outlier_biota_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill)
grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill$data <- grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill$data |>
  mutate(SAMPLING_YEAR = factor(year(SAMPLING_DATE)))
grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill_unit <- grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill$summary$unit
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-outlier-year-Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill
#| fig-cap: "Fish / Abramis brama / Gill: measured value by sampling year."
#| fig-height: !expr outlier_fig_height(grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill$data$SAMPLING_YEAR)
plot_outlier_distribution(
  grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill$data,
  facet_col = "SAMPLING_YEAR",
  x_label = paste0("Measured value (", grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill_unit, ")"),
  y_label = "Year",
  min_n = 10
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-outlier-year-Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill
outlier_flag_table(flag_by_facet(grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill$data, "SAMPLING_YEAR", min_n = 10))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-outlier-site-Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill
#| fig-cap: "Fish / Abramis brama / Gill: measured value by site."
#| fig-height: !expr outlier_fig_height(grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill$data$SITE_CODE, base = 4)
plot_outlier_distribution(
  grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill$data,
  facet_col = "SITE_CODE",
  x_label = paste0("Measured value (", grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill_unit, ")"),
  y_label = "Site",
  panel_facet = "SITE_GEOGRAPHIC_FEATURE",
  min_n = 10
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-outlier-site-Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill
outlier_flag_table(flag_by_facet(grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill$data, "SITE_CODE", min_n = 10))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-outlier-campaign-Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill
#| fig-cap: "Fish / Abramis brama / Gill: measured value by campaign."
#| fig-height: !expr outlier_fig_height(grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill$data$CAMPAIGN_NAME_SHORT)
plot_outlier_distribution(
  grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill$data,
  facet_col = "CAMPAIGN_NAME_SHORT",
  x_label = paste0("Measured value (", grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill_unit, ")"),
  y_label = "Campaign",
  min_n = 10
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-outlier-campaign-Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill
outlier_flag_table(flag_by_facet(grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill$data, "CAMPAIGN_NAME_SHORT", min_n = 10))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-outlier-treatment-Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill
#| fig-cap: "Fish / Abramis brama / Gill: effect of outlier treatment on the pooled distribution."
plot_outlier_treatment_comparison(
  grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill,
  x_label = paste0("Measured value (", grp_Fish_Abramis_brama_Gill_unit, ")")
```
